runSummary.stalePolicy: LIVE eligibility requires real source verification and link evidence. Existing LIVE items are never removed merely because a discovery run does not rediscover them.
runSummary.note: Real 14.9.2026 21:49 sweep across 12 source families: Profesia, direct company careers/public ATS, LinkedIn public jobs indexing, Worki, Kariera/Zoznam, Brigada.sk, Sluzby zamestnanosti, Pretlak/StartupJobs/WordPress Jobs, Upwork/Freelancermap, Reddit/WordPress communities and publicly indexed Facebook groups. Strongest new adjacent candidate is ALUFIX SLOVAKIA Administrativny pracovnik/cka, Analytik/cka in Bratislava at 1,900 EUR/month with occasional home office and strong admin/product-catalog/marketing overlap; however explicit B2 English plus an English CV/cover-letter requirement are material penalties for the A2 profile, so it is promotion-ready only, not a top recommendation. LinkedIn reverified ESET Customer Support Specialist in Bratislava, but B2 English and 1,250 EUR base make it materially weaker. Facebook produced 0 verified direct-post hits. No LIVE deletion was performed.

developmentChanges.title: Source-family evidence TTL
developmentChanges.reason: Assign a freshness TTL by source family and evidence surface so fast-changing boards and freelance marketplaces are rechecked sooner than stable employer pages. This avoids wasting cycles while preventing stale promotion claims.

developmentChanges.title: Rejected-candidate recheck expiry
developmentChanges.reason: Persist rejection reasons with an expiry window. Hard mismatches such as mandatory C1 language can be cooled down longer, while mutable reasons such as proposal saturation, salary or remote policy are rechecked sooner if the listing remains active.
